page.overview:
Who is Dark Moon?

Dark Moon is a male background unicorn pony who appears in several episodes throughout the show. He has a dark gray coat, gray mane and tail, blue eyes, and a cutie mark of a white crescent moon. He is not named in the show, but he is named in merchandise.__TOC__

Dark Moon shares his design and eye color with Neon Lights, "Flank Sinatra", S02E26 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #1, and unicorn Shooting Star, shares his design with "Purple Stuff", and shares his mane and tail style and eye color with Star Hunter, Twilight Sky, and "Cosmic".

Dark Moon appears as a conceptual Pegasus pony in incidental male pony artwork by Robin Mitchell for Lauren Faust.

In The Super Speedy Cider Squeezy 6000, Dark Moon watches the cider competition between Applejack's family and Flim and Flam, and in A Canterlot Wedding - Part 2, he appears at both wedding ceremonies.
